question: The “Double Dome” feature of Indo - Islamic architecture was introduced by which dynasty of Delhi Sultanate?
solution:
The correct answer is Lodi Dynasty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Double Dome:-**

 
 
• **The double dome consists of two domes, one inner and one outer, with a space between them. **
 
• The inner dome is smaller and supports the weight of the outer dome. This design allows for taller and more slender domes, and it also creates a dramatic visual effect.
 
• **The Lodi dynasty introduced the "double dome" feature of Indo-Islamic architecture. **
 
• The first example of a double dome in Indo-Islamic architecture is the tomb of Sikandar Lodi (1517/18) in Delhi. Other notable examples include the tomb of Humayun (1572) in Delhi, the Taj Mahal (1648) in Agra, and the Jama Masjid (1656) in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Lodi dynasty:-**
 
 
• It was the last dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, ruling from 1451 to 1526.
 
• During their reign, they made significant contributions to Indo-Islamic architecture, including the introduction of the double dome.
 
• The Lodi style of architecture is characterized by its simplicity, elegance, and use of high-quality materials.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Slave Dynasty:-**

 
 
• **It was the first dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, which ruled over northern India from 1206 to 1290. **
 
• The dynasty was founded by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, who was a former slave of the Ghurid Sultan Muhammad of Ghor. 
 
 
 
• **Khilji Dynasty:-**
 
 
• **It was the second dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, ruling over northern India from 1290 to 1320. **
 
• The dynasty was founded by Jalal-ud-din Firoz Khilji, who was a former slave of the Mamluk dynasty.
 
• Jalal-ud-din was a skilled and ambitious general, and he quickly rose through the ranks of the Mamluk military.
 
• In 1290, he assassinated the last Mamluk sultan and seized control of Delhi for himself.
 
 
 
• **Tughlaq Dynasty:-**
 
 
• **It was the third dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, ruling over northern India from 1320 to 1413. **
 
• The dynasty was founded by Ghazi Malik, who ascended the throne under the title of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq.
 
• The Tughlaq Dynasty was a period of great expansion and consolidation for the Delhi Sultanate.
